planets.name: TOI-672 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-672 with a 3.63-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-672 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-672. Its orbit and size follow Osborn et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname OSBORN_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2023, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.633575, pl_radj 0.47372729, pl_bmassj 0.16014931

quotes.title: TOI-672 b
quotes.card: TOI-672 b is a Neptune-like exoplanet, located 218 light-years away.
quotes.introduction: The exoplanet was discovered in the year 2023.
